C0.quote: A proposer (P, she) negotiates with a responder (R, he)
C0.note: The paper studies two-player bargaining with agenda choice and learning about the proposer's persuasion ability. A single proposer makes offers that a single responder accepts or rejects. There is no procedure that aggregates several agents' inputs into a collective decision by voting. Congress is modelled as one responder, not as a set of voters. Coding stopped per C0.
